# charactercheck
Deterministic D&D Beyond character-sheet derivation with provenance. Every
stat computed and traceable; every unhandled case named with its blast
radius; player-authority live state is never guessed. Install: pip install
charactercheck. CLI: charactercheck derive|seatpack|stance|quiz|diff|report
<ddb-url-or-json>. MCP server: io.github.chaoz23/charactercheck. Exit codes:
0 clean, 1 lint, 2 unhandled-content (honest refusal, not failure). Ask it:
"what is this character's AC and why", "everything a seat needs at session
start", "what changed on this sheet since intake".

## Bootstrapping

`charactercheck selftest` derives a bundled sample character offline and prints
PASS/FAIL per check. Run it first: it proves the engine works without a network,
a D&D Beyond account, or a character of your own, which isolates any remaining
problem to access rather than to the tool. `AGENTS.md` at the repo root is the
one-page agent guide.

## The trust map (v0.6)

`derive` returns a `trust` block routing every family into exactly one lane:
`trusted` (safe to state), `ask_player` (in doubt — the resolving question is
included), `unsupported` (content the engine does not model targets this
family). Unsupported content is never applied, so the rest of the arithmetic
stands. Every lint entry is {code, message, ask, affects} and carries a
question a GM can read aloud. `--brief` renders it chat-sized; `intake` emits a
pre-session packet.

## Failure contract (read this before filing anything)

Exit codes: 0 derived clean · 1 lint findings · 2 unhandled content (NOT a
failure — output is complete and usable) · **3 could not retrieve the sheet**.

Exit 3 prints structured JSON with a stable `error` kind and a one-sentence
`action`: not_public, not_found, bad_ref, network, rate_limited, bad_json,
upstream. There is never a traceback.

Private character? charactercheck never asks for credentials. Either set
Character Privacy to Public on D&D Beyond, or save the character-service JSON
and pass the file path — that needs no permissions at all.

Stuck? `charactercheck doctor <ref>` checks python, DNS, outbound HTTPS and
character reachability, and prints the remedy on the first failing check.
